about: I'm currently studying T Level Digital Support and Security at Exeter College.

My interest in cloud computing developed through my involvement in an AWS college project, where I took responsibility for supporting cloud infrastructure behind a web application. Since then, I've expanded my practical experience with AWS by designing and configuring VPCs, public and private subnets, route tables, security groups and EC2 instances. I've also gained experience implementing load balancing, auto scaling, IAM roles and CloudWatch monitoring, while continuing to develop my knowledge of Linux, Bash scripting and cloud networking through independent projects.

I'm working towards a career in network and cloud infrastructure engineering, and I'm applying for Digital and Technology Solutions degree apprenticeships because I want to develop my technical knowledge while gaining hands-on experience in real enterprise environments. I'm particularly interested in designing, building and securing large-scale IT infrastructure, learning from experienced professionals and applying what I learn to real-world challenges.
